policy.title: Privacy Policy of the Qvrix Website
policy.intro: We, Eldar Memetov, operating under the name Qvrix (hereinafter referred to as the “Controller”), take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We process personal data exclusively in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the applicable national data protection laws, in particular the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and the Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act (TDDDG). This Privacy Policy explains which data we process, for what purposes, on which legal basis, and which rights you are entitled to. Last updated: January 2026.

sections.title: 2. General Principles of Processing
sections.description: We process personal data only to the extent necessary for the operation of the website, the handling of inquiries, and the provision of our services, or where another legal basis exists. Depending on the specific processing activity, we rely in particular on the following legal bases:
points: Article 6(1)(a) GDPR — consent, where required for specific functions;
Article 6(1)(b) GDPR — performance of a contract and pre-contractual measures taken at your request;
Article 6(1)(c) GDPR — compliance with legal obligations;
Article 6(1)(f) GDPR — legitimate interests, particularly in the secure, stable, and functional provision of our website.

sections.title: 3. Hosting, Technical Provision and Server Log Files
sections.description: This website is hosted by Vercel. Services provided by Render.com may additionally be used for server-side functions and the processing of form submissions. Both providers process technical data in connection with the provision, security, and stability of the website. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) pursuant to Article 28 GDPR has been concluded with Vercel.

subsections.title: 3.1. Automatically Processed Data
points: Browser type and version;
Operating system used;
Referrer URL;
Hostname and IP address;
Date and time of the server request;
Accessed page or file;
Amount of data transferred;
HTTP status code;
Technical information for error analysis and security purposes.

subsections.title: 3.2. Legal Basis and Storage Period
points: The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, as we have a legitimate interest in the secure, fast, and stable operation of our website.
Server log files are stored only for as long as necessary for security, troubleshooting, and operational purposes and are subsequently deleted unless longer retention is required.
These data are not merged with other data sources unless necessary for troubleshooting, preventing misuse, or required by law.

subsections.title: 3.3. Data Processing and Transfers to Third Countries
points: Vercel Inc., 340 Pine Street, Suite 701, San Francisco, CA 94104, USA, is engaged as a processor within the meaning of Article 28 GDPR.
Render.com may be used for server-side functions and processes technical data as a processor.
Depending on the technical processing involved, personal data may be transferred to the United States.
Where required, such transfers are based on appropriate safeguards under Chapter V GDPR, particularly Standard Contractual Clauses and, where applicable, recognized adequacy mechanisms.

sections.title: 4. Cookies and Local Storage
sections.description: Our website uses only technically necessary cookies or comparable local storage technologies. We currently do not use analytics, marketing, or tracking services such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, or similar services.

subsections.title: 4.1. Technically Necessary Storage
points: If consent preferences or language settings are stored locally in the browser, this may be done using localStorage or a comparable local storage technology.
localStorage is a client-side browser storage feature; these data are not automatically transmitted to our servers.
The storage of or access to information on your device is permitted only to the extent strictly necessary to provide the digital service explicitly requested by you (Section 25(2) TDDDG).

subsections.title: 4.2. Optional Services Not Used
points: We currently do not use optional analytics, marketing, or tracking services.
Should such services be introduced in the future, they will only be used with your prior consent in accordance with Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and Section 25(1) TDDDG.
Any consent given may be withdrawn at any time with effect for the future.
